singleSourced.value: making deliberate choices to align talent and investment where we see the greatest opportunities for players and long-term growth
singleSourced.context: In its announcement memo, EA said it was "making deliberate choices to align talent and investment where we see the greatest opportunities for players and long-term growth" - hence the decision to lay off 400 workers and cut BioWare entirely.
EA itself was recently taken private by the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, Jared Kushner's private equity group Affinity Partners and Silver Lake in a $55bn leveraged buyout.
Battlefield 6 players made a mental note of an incoming Mass Effect collab when themed content was added to cosmetic menus with the launch of Season 5 earlier this month.

The cosmetics included several N7 logos in patches and on weapons, as well as a charm of the Normandy, Commander Shepard’s ship in the original trilogy.
